name: numinix/seekmodo-zen-cart-connector
description: Seekmodo connector for Zen Cart 1.5.7c+. Composer is used ONLY at build time (tools/build_release.py) to pull the shared numinix/seekmodo-connector SDK and vendor it into the plugin tree. The plugin itself does NOT require composer at runtime - we vendor the SDK source files into zc_plugins/Seekmodo/<ver>/catalog/includes/library/Numinix/SeekmodoSdk/ and rely on the plugin's manual PSR-4 autoloader (init_numinix_seekmodo.php).
